entries.title: Your first mate applies a setting you chose on a crewmate's card
entries.body: When you choose a setting on a crewmate's card, or ask for one while your first mate is working, your first mate now applies it without you asking again. Each change still shows in Activity. Removing a project, disconnecting an account, changing the projects folder or signing out still waits for words you typed.
entries.noPicture: This changes when the first mate may apply a setting; Settings and the window look as they did.
